silhouette.reason: Swept hair, full beard and the profile nose read as a bearded man; the red mantle still forms two round sleeve-balloons that dominate the outline in FRONT and hero.png.
fixes: cut the mantle with a seam and a draped fold over each shoulder instead of puffed ellipsoids

proportions.reason: Shoulders are narrower than before and the beard blends into the cheek; the mantle masses are still bulbous for the head and the face reads young and doll-like for the beard.
fixes: flatten the shoulder masses ~10 % on top
deepen the eye sockets and cheek planes so the face ages with the beard

materials.reason: Skin, hair, red wool, blue tunic, linen and a metallic brass collar separate by hue; mantle and tunic share one matte roughness, the skin is waxy, and the hair cards show white fringe specks at the crown in hero.png.
fixes: wool strip with fibre noise on the mantle and a linen strip on the tunic
skin roughness variation (oily T-zone, matte cheeks)
premultiply / darken the hair card alpha fringe so no white specks show

detail.reason: Lids, beard locks, hair cards, brass studs and a collar plate hold up; the mantle and tunic are smooth with no folds, hems or seams.
fixes: fold lines and a hemmed edge on the mantle

wear.reason: Darker grime patches on the mantle and a soiled collar suggest use; the face and tunic are pristine.
fixes: sun weathering or a small scar on the face

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the outline and the beard, and the blue tunic now stays one block; but the brass collar becomes a jagged cream zigzag, hair colour bleeds onto the forehead and cheek, and the brow/nose mass flattens.
fixes: keep the brow/nose mass at LOD2
average per-face colour at LOD2 so the collar keeps its brass hue and the hair colour stays off the face

technical.reason: 65k / 19.5k / 3k triangles, 5 draws: down from 100k, still heavy for a bust.
fixes: trim LOD0 toward ~45k on the mantle and plinth
merge the cornea/cutout draws where possible
